title: kanban: offer lookup, user, master-detail and tree fields in the lane-field picker (item 4 split from #36430)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · item 4 of #36430, split off by seat repo:objectstack#1 when PR #36642 (items 1–3) landed. The card thread's edit outside its first surface was not made in that PR.

## What
After PR #36642, a board grouped by a lookup, user, master-detail or tree field draws one lane per referenced record, titled by its name. Cards are bucketed by the foreign key, and a drag writes that key. But the list's lane-field picker still offers only `select` and `radio` fields (`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`, the `laneFieldOptions` filter), so an admin cannot choose a reference field from the UI. Only a hand-written `groupBy` reaches it.

## Done when
- The lane-field picker offers single-valued lookup, user, master-detail and tree fields. A multi-valued reference is not offered.
- A plugin-list test pins the offered types.
- Choosing an owner field in the picker gives #36430's acceptance: one lane per owner, and a drag changes the owner.

Also noted on PR #36642 (sibling, same family): a `swimlaneField` on a reference field still stringifies to `[object Object]` (KanbanImpl). This card may take it if the fix is the same `laneKeyOf` reuse. Otherwise it gets a card of its own.

reach: every admin who builds a board by owner or account from the UI.
Business reason: the fix in #36642 is unreachable from the picker.
Reader: `domain:ui` (plugin-list lane picker, plugin-kanban).
Dedupe: `laneFieldOptions lookup`, `kanban lane picker user field` → none.
Grade suggestion: p1, as item 4 of the p1 card it was split from. Triage decides.
